Smoldyn particles bounded by cpm cells

A particle simulator composed with a multicellular one: each cpm cell is a moving boundary, and a Smoldyn sim runs inside each one — particles reflect off the cell boundary and react (A + B ⇌ C). Particles are coloured by their cell (matching the outline); on division a cell's molecules split into the two daughters. cell 1cell 2cell 3cell 4cell 1.1cell 2.1cell 3.1cell 4.1cell 1.2cell 3.2cell 4.2cell 1.1.1
